description: This file defines a PasswordHasher class that implements an interface for hashing passwords using HMACSHA512. It provides functionality to hash passwords with a salt asynchronously.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A class that implements password hashing using HMACSHA512, providing an async Hash method and Dispose method.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Generates a hashed byte array asynchronously for a given password and salt.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the HMACSHA512 instance to free resources.
